truth_semantics: An option is true only when its assertion is justified by the displayed stem, not by silently adding an omitted physical condition. Statements using sign conditions assert a generally valid implication. Conditional sets for a repaired stem are explicitly separate from the current-view set.

questions.stem: 哪一项正确说明加速度表征什么，以及知道它有什么用？

options.text: 一段时间内的平均加速度是速度矢量改变量与时间的比值；加速度恒定时，可结合初速度和时间求以后速度。
options.reason: Average acceleration is Delta-v/Delta-t; with constant acceleration, v(t)=v0+a*t. The finite-interval quantity is explicitly called average, not instantaneous.

options.text: 一段时间内的平均加速度是位移矢量改变量与时间的比值；加速度恒定时，只需初位置和时间就可求以后位置。
options.reason: A displacement change divided by time is not acceleration. Initial position and time alone do not determine later position, even when acceleration is constant.

options.text: 一段时间内的平均加速度就是速度矢量的改变量；加速度恒定时，把加速度与初速度直接相加即可求以后速度。
options.reason: The elapsed-time divisor is missing. Acceleration and velocity have different dimensions; the velocity increment is a*t, not a alone.

options.text: 一段时间内的平均加速度就是物体开始时的速度；知道初速度，就能确定加速度并求以后任一时刻的速度。
options.reason: Initial velocity is not acceleration and does not determine acceleration or all future velocities.

questions.stem: 在某一时刻，$v$ 和 $a$ 分别是速度、加速度在同一固定坐标轴上的投影，且 $v\ne0$。以下哪些说法正确？
questions.finding: The stem does not state that motion is along the chosen axis. One component's signs do not determine total speed change: d|V|/dt=(V dot A)/|V|, not v*a/|v| in general. The original source question is about straight-line speeding/slowing. Require motion along the stated axis; do not silently redefine total speed as absolute projection.
questions.suggested_minimal_stem_condition: 物体沿该坐标轴做直线运动
questions.counterexample_units: Velocity components in m/s, acceleration components in m/s^2.

options.text: $v>0$、$a>0$ 时，速度的大小正在增大。
options.reason: Not guaranteed for total speed. V=(1,2), A=(1,-2) meet positive X-projection conditions but V dot A=-3, so speed decreases. With axis-aligned motion, v*a>0 would mean speed increases.

options.text: $v<0$、$a<0$ 时，速度的大小正在增大。
options.reason: Not guaranteed for total speed. V=(-1,2), A=(-1,-2) meet negative X-projection conditions but V dot A=-3, so speed decreases. With axis-aligned motion, v*a>0 would mean speed increases.

options.text: $v>0$、$a<0$ 时，速度的大小正在减小。
options.reason: Not guaranteed for total speed. V=(1,2), A=(-1,2) meet the stated X-projection conditions but V dot A=3, so speed increases. With axis-aligned motion, v*a<0 would mean speed decreases.

options.text: $v<0$、$a>0$ 时，速度的大小正在增大。
options.reason: The displayed conditions do not generally imply increasing total speed. V=(-1,0), A=(1,0) meet the conditions but V dot A=-1, so speed decreases. In the intended one-dimensional case, v*a<0 also means decreasing speed.

questions.stem: 对于本课讨论的变速运动，哪一项足以说明它是匀加速运动？

options.text: 速度的大小均匀增加，但速度方向可以任意变化。
options.reason: Uniform increase of scalar speed with arbitrary changing direction does not imply constant vector acceleration.

options.text: 在任意相等的时间间隔内，速度矢量的改变量都相等。
options.reason: Equal vector-velocity changes over every equal time interval are the defining constant-acceleration condition.

options.text: 加速度的大小保持不变，但加速度方向可以任意变化。
options.reason: Constant acceleration magnitude alone is insufficient; its direction must also be constant.

options.text: 速度方向保持不变，但速度的大小可以任意变化。
options.reason: Fixed velocity direction permits nonuniform changes of speed and does not ensure constant acceleration.

questions.stem: 无轨电车从静止开始，以 $1.5$ 米/秒$^2$ 的恒定加速度运动。达到 $54$ 千米/小时需要多长时间？

options.reason: 54/1.5=36 uses the unconverted km/h number with m/s^2; the consistent calculation gives 10 s.
22.5 is not (15-0)/1.5; multiplying 15 by 1.5 does not give the elapsed time.
Matches the independently frozen result 10 s.
0.1 is the reciprocal of the correct numerical time, not the required elapsed time.

questions.stem: 汽车的初速度为 $36$ 千米/秒，制动后经过 $4$ 秒停止。制动时恒定加速度的大小是多少？
questions.independent_derivation: Literal 36 km/s=36000 m/s; acceleration magnitude=(36000-0)/4=9000 m/s^2. Signed acceleration is -9000 m/s^2 on an axis along initial velocity.

options.reason: Matches the independently frozen magnitude using literal km/s.
36/4=9 is in km/s^2, not m/s^2; the metre-unit result is 9000.
This would follow from substituting 36 km/h, which is not the seed or displayed unit.
36000*4=144000 is not the required speed-change divided by elapsed-time calculation.

questions.stem: 载重汽车的速度从 $15$ 米/秒增加到 $25$ 米/秒，恒定加速度为 $1.6$ 米/秒$^2$。这次速度增加用了多长时间？

options.reason: 25/1.6 uses final speed instead of the 10 m/s change and ignores nonzero initial speed.
10*1.6=16 multiplies instead of dividing the speed change by acceleration.
1.6/10=0.16 inverts the required ratio.
Matches the independently frozen elapsed time 6.25 s.

questions.stem: 物体做恒定加速度的减速直线运动，加速度大小为 $10$ 米/秒$^2$，经过 $0.5$ 小时速度降为零。在这段减速过程中，最大速度是多少？
questions.independent_derivation: 0.5 h=1800 s; with a=-10 m/s^2 along initial motion and final v=0, v0=10*1800=18000 m/s. Speed decreases during the stated stopping interval, so its maximum is v0.

options.reason: 300 would use 30 s, not the stated 1800 s; half an hour is not half a minute.
Matches the frozen interval-specific maximum speed 18000 m/s.
10*0.5=5 treats the half-hour number as seconds and omits conversion.
The time conversion is 1800 s, but the speed requires multiplication by acceleration magnitude10, yielding 18000 m/s.
